A1.justification: Both PDFs describe VQ-SGen and provide readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and complete supplementary material. Content can be matched reliably across the appendix additions and figure renumbering.

before.justification: v2 reports original Creative Birds/Creative Creatures benchmarks, ablations, a 50-participant user study, and conditional-generation and reconstruction experiments.

after.justification: v3 retains those original empirical results and adds a DiffSketcher parameter comparison and a Sketchformer-based encoding experiment.

M1.justification: The stroke representation, separate shape/location codebooks, cascaded Transformers, losses, training stages, and inference procedure are retained. The new Sketchformer substitution is an experimental comparison variant of the existing pipeline.

E1.justification: Creative Birds, Creative Creatures, the 20-class QuickDraw subset, and QuickDraw reconstruction examples remain. The additions examine existing generation and reconstruction tasks; the replaced Figure 7 prompt does not establish expanded task or domain coverage.

E2.justification: Appendix E newly evaluates a point-sequence variant using Sketchformer against the bitmap-based model. Sketchformer was previously discussed but not evaluated in this comparison. The main benchmark comparators remain unchanged; DiffSketcher already appeared in v2.

E3.justification: New Figure A4 tests DiffSketcher with paired stroke-count/CFG settings of (10,20), (20,50), and (35,100) for two prompts. The new encoder comparison reports reconstruction Acc/Rec alongside generation metrics. Appendix B also corrects the assignment of N=35 to Creative Creatures, without establishing that retained experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: v3 adds a targeted test of bitmap versus point-sequence encoding and extends the DiffSketcher analysis by varying stroke count and guidance weight. Existing component ablations, codebook analyses, interpolation, generalization examples, and failure cases are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions state that different random seeds were tried for DiffSketcher without specifying counts. v3 introduces no repeated-run counts, uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals, or significance tests; the added numerical comparisons retain the existing reporting practice.

E6.justification: Appendix E adds Sketchformer-variant versus bitmap Acc/Rec of 0.44/0.32 versus 0.96/0.97 and FID/GD/CS of 75.42/12.31/0.16 versus 15.78/18.92/0.53. Figure A4 adds qualitative outcomes, and Figures 7(b)/A3 replace VQ-SGen examples. Tables 1, 2, A1 and the user-study chart are unchanged.

T1.justification: The sketch and VQ definitions, losses, autoregressive factorization, and Equations (1)–(6) are retained. No formal assumptions, proofs, or mathematical derivations are added or revised.

C1.justification: The introduction and first contribution replace the claim of the 'first' stroke-level approach with a 'novel' approach, withdrawing the explicit priority claim. The central method, performance, and application claims retain their scope.

C2.justification: Appendix D adds discussion of the abstraction–recognizability tradeoff when tuning DiffSketcher. Appendix E interprets the encoding comparison as supporting bitmap representation for generation. Existing limitations concerning codebook search, disconnected strokes, and hard cropping remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v3 adds a project-page URL and removes v2's promise of future code/model release; actual release availability cannot be established from the PDFs. Appendix B resolves the duplicated Creative Birds label by assigning N=35 to Creative Creatures. The new experiments also identify their encoder substitution and DiffSketcher parameter values.

R1.justification: The same 45 cited works and related-work section are retained. Positioning is narrowed by dropping the priority claim, while Appendix E explicitly distinguishes its generation comparison from ContextSeg's segmentation evidence and evaluates the already-cited Sketchformer.

P1.justification: v3 adds acknowledgments and short discussions in Appendices D/E, revises the novelty wording, and makes small grammatical and dataset-label corrections. Most prose and the section organization are retained.

P2.justification: Figure 7(b) and the VQ-SGen examples in Figure A3 change, and a new parameter-comparison Figure A4 is added. Earlier Figures A4–A7 are retained as A5–A8 with appendix reflow. The main diagrams, tables, and overall two-column design remain.

improvement.justification: The added encoding experiment provides direct generation evidence for the bitmap design, supplementing v2's reliance on related-work comparisons. The DiffSketcher parameter exploration broadens the existing qualitative comparison, and the corrected training detail and narrower novelty claim improve precision. These are limited gains: the main findings are unchanged, and the new encoding experiment gives sparse setup and metric detail.
